policies.title: Botswanan ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule lists Botswana as requiring no visitor visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Botswanan passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The no-visa category means a visa is not required; work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain separate.
The live-linked schedule is dated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.

policies.title: Botswanan ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly lists Botswana in its no-visa-required cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Botswanan passport holder travelling as a tourist for up to three months.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier requirements and final admission remain outside scope.
